text:
Leila (growth): Quick thread 1: Sunset Pier pop-up is Thurs eve. Need final checklist + one-liner benchmark for handouts and social post. Main asks: 1) final swag counts, 2) speaker-run order (10m lightning + 10m Q&A), 3) QR sign-up prefill for webinar, 4) lead routing tags for CRM. Who can own?
Omar (events): I'll own volunteers and venue ops. AV: projector + HDMI, one power strip, two chairs. Speaker is Priya (confirmed). We have room for a 3-panel tabletop and a 24x36 poster. Door opens 17:30, talk at 18:45. Can we have materials on site by 16:30?
Dana (ops): Shipping ETA: swag pallet arrives Wed 15:00. Current counts at staging: 140 stickers, 30 tees (split S/M/L), 120 postcards, 1 roll of vinyl banner. I can consolidate into 1 courier pickup on Wed morning. Will print badges Monday if we finalize CSV.
Hiro (designer): I'll finalize the poster tonight. Suggested hero headline: "Serve LLMs predictably at scale". For the small benchmark blurb: "Avg. 30% token-cost reduction over baseline in real-user traces" 1ow bold? we can soften. I'll upload print-safe PDFs.
Leila (growth): Keep the blurb conservative: maybe "~30% lower token cost in production traces". Also want two short social hooks for live post and for webinar follow-up.
Marta (sales): Quick ask: tag leads with "interest:dedicated" or "interest:private" so SDRs can prioritize. Also flag any onsite requests for a dedicated demo.
Omar (events): Volunteers: @Noah (17:15-19:00), @Jules (19:00-21:30). I'll bring the card reader but can someone confirm we have Venmo/Square fallback?
Dana (ops): Card reader: we have Square + backup Reader2 in the kit. I'll bring both. Also label template for badges:
```
name,email,company,utm_campaign,source,interest_tag
```
Please populate utm_campaign=sunset_pier, source=meetup.
Hiro (designer): Uploaded assets: https://figma.com/file/sunsetpier/hiro-assets. Poster v2 is print-ready. Colors: use primary navy #061b33 for large prints.
Leila (growth): Webinar flow: onsite leads get an immediate checkbox for "Attend deep-dive webinar". If checked, auto-add to "sunset_followup" list and send invite within 24h. Nurture cadence: Day0 invite, Day3 reminder, Day7 recording + benchmark dataset. Also one key email variant for attendees who asked about SSO/KMS features.
Omar (events): Can we hand out a 1-pager w/ short benchmark + CTA to sign up for the webinar? If yes, Hiro please include the one-liner and a short QR code area.
Hiro (designer): Yes 1pager will include bench blurb, 3 bullet features, QR prefill instructions. QR should encode: ?utm_campaign=sunset_pier&utm_source=meetup&prefill&utm=1. Who QA?
Dana (ops): I'll QA QR on iOS and Android tonight. Also will run a quick script to export CSV after event:
```
export-leads --source meetup --campaign sunset_pier --output sunset_leads.csv
```
Make sure volunteers capture notes column for "product_interest".
Marta (sales): After export, sales wants a column "sq_priority" (low/med/high) based on onsite answers. We'll triage within 48h. Also mark SLED or enterprise asks.
Leila (growth): Social copy drafts: A) "Catching up with builders at Sunset Pier tonight! Stop by to see predictable LLM inference in action. Live demo + giveaways. RSVP -> [link]" B) Post-event: "Missed Sunset Pier? Register for our webinar for the full benchmarks and Q&A: [link]" Which subject line for webinar invite we should A/B?
Marta (sales): A/B: "See the benchmarks: live webinar" vs "Webinar: how we cut token costs 30%". Second is more specific.
Omar (events): Logistics checklist: tablecloth, double-sided tape, 2x extension cords, cable lock for laptop, backup HDMI dongle, tape measure. Can someone confirm we have 2 clipboards for pen signups?
Dana (ops): I have 3 clipboards in the kit. Also printing instruction for vendor: double-sided 1-pager on 100lb silk, bleed 0.125in. I'll upload PO to vendor X by EOD.
Hiro (designer): One more design ask: small sponsor strip on bottom, leave 0.5in margin. Also provide a short promo code to track conversions 1 use "SUNSET10".
Leila (growth): Promo code is live. We'll include it on the one-pager and in the follow-up email. Please ensure coupon is tied to source=meetup.
Marta (sales): Volunteers: please ask one quick qualifying Q: "Are you building with hosted, dedicated, or private infra?" Tag responses. That's enough for SDRs to route.
Omar (events): Confirmed: I'll be on site at 16:00 for load-in. Volunteers will do a 20m run at 17:00. Reminder ping will go to #events at 15:30.
EventBot: Reminder scheduled -> load-in @16:00 Wed, volunteer run @17:00 Thu.
Leila (growth): Final owners: Vols & timing (Omar), Shipping & labels (Dana), Assets & print (Hiro), Lead flow & webinar sequence (Leila). If no objections I'll post the attendees email template tomorrow. :rocket:
Noah: I'll test QR tonight on Android.
Jules: I'll bring an extra phone and battery pack.
Dana (ops): Uploaded labels CSV template: //shared/marketing/sunset_labels_template.csv
Leila (growth): Thanks all. Closing the loop 1 I'll post the webinar invite copy in this thread for review at 10:00am tomorrow.
